subject: MPA: Testcase & Promptpack Exchange — Onboarding protocol and constraints
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@nimble-retail.com>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimble-retail.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: exchange of testcases and prompt pack for evaluation

Hi Hiro / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency/cost numbers look promising for the types of search-and-recommend flows we run. Our product team would like to run a focused evaluation against a subset of our testcases before we commit to a pilot.

We can share a prompt pack and a ~2k-row testcase CSV (obfuscated PII) but have a few requirements up front:
- Ephemeral access only: the dataset must not be retained beyond the evaluation period (60 days) and must not be used for model training.
- Access controls: access limited to team-controlled IP ranges and specific service accounts.
- Auditability: we need basic audit logs for token usage and files accessed during the evaluation.
- No redistribution: the asset cannot be shared with third parties.

Attached is an initial promptpack and a small sample of the testcases (nimble_promptpack_request_v1.zip). If Redwood can accept the constraints above, can you send over your standard MPA + any required security attestation we should route to procurement?

Goal timeline we have in mind:
- 12/03: sign MPA and mutual NDAs for the eval pack
- 12/06–12/13: evaluation run (we'll provide sample eval scripts)
- 12/15: sync to review results and next steps

Thanks — Nora

Nora Patel
Director, Product Experiments
NimbleRetail
Attachments: nimble_promptpack_request_v1.zip (archive, ~2.3 MB)

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@nimble-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: exchange of testcases and prompt pack for evaluation

Hi Nora — thanks for the clear ask and for the sample. We can absolutely support an ephemeral exchange with the constraints you list; below is a proposed lightweight MPA and operational plan to keep things fast.

High-level proposal (summary):
- MPA scope: 60-day evaluation window; dataset marked for ephemeral access only; no training/use beyond evaluation; retention and deletion audit logging included.
- Access: temporary service account(s) created in your tenant; we're proposing IP allowlist + short-lived tokens (7-day) rotated by us.
- Observability: provide token-level metrics and a short access log extract each week; we cannot give raw operator logs but will provide consolidated audit reports.
- Security attestation: attach our standard SOC2 summary and the minimal controls checklist you requested.

Attachments: redwood_mpa_draft_Nimble_v1.docx (draft MPA), SOC2-summary-2026.pdf (attestation)

Proposed timeline (we can compress):
- 12/03: sign MPA (we'll send DocuSign link)
- 12/04: Redwood creates ephemeral sandbox and pre-provisions service account(s)
- 12/06–12/13: evaluation run (Nimble team runs scripts against sandbox)
- 12/15: results review and go/no-go

Two quick questions for procurement: who should we put on the DocuSign and do you have a PO template?

Ben — looping you in for pricing approval and standard concession guidance (any one-off retention exceptions we should approve now?).

Thanks,
Hiro

Hiro Tanaka
Director, Partnerships & Strategic Trials
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_mpa_draft_Nimble_v1.docx (draft MPA)

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 09:12 AM Nora Patel <nora.patel@nimble-retail.com> wrote:
> [original message quoted above]

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 14:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: NimbleRetail MPA — proposed concession and OPS notes

Marissa / Ben — quick internal note before I send the DocuSign link. Nimble asked for audit logs and an IP-bound access model. Ops confirmed we can provide consolidated audit extracts (token counts, service-account access entries) but not full raw host logs. Also Ops says we can do an IP allowlist for the sandbox pool but need authorization for a 30-day retention window on our side for debug traces (masked) if we see anything anomalous.

Recommendation: approve the 30-day masked-trace retention for Redwood diagnostics only (explicitly excluded from training or product research), and keep the customer's 60-day deletion requirement for everything else. If that's OK I will: 1) update the MPA draft with the diagnostics clause, 2) send DocuSign to Nora + procurement, and 3) schedule the sandbox provisioning for 12/04.

If Ben gives the go, I'll proceed.

— Hiro

(Note: internal email — do not forward outside Redwood)

From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@nimble-retail.com>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimble-retail.com
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 16:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: exchange of testcases and prompt pack for evaluation

Hiro — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the clarity on logs. Procurement confirms PO flow and is happy to sign the MPA as long as the clause is limited to 30 days for Redwood diagnostics and explicitly excludes training and model improvement. Attached is the assigned procurement contact and a signed redline to the MPA (we used Track Changes in Word).

DocuSign will be fine. Procurement contact:
- Dana Liu (procurement@nimble-retail.com)

We accept the timeline and will hand off the sample eval scripts by 12/05. Please send the DocuSign link and sandbox credentials (service account name only — do not email secrets).
